item.title: Montréal Canadiens Make Coaching Change
item.description: It has not been a stellar season between the pipes for the Montreal Canadiens. Goaltender coach Eric Raymond has now paid the price, being relieved of his duties. He's been replaced (on an "interim" basis for the rest of this season) by the AHL Laval Rockets goalie coach Marco Marciano.NEWS: The Montréal Canadiens have fired Goaltending Coach Éric Raymond. item.title: NHL Rumors: Flames' Zach Whitecloud Drawing a Lot of Trade Interest
item.description: The Calgary Flames wrapped up the Rasmus Andersson saga on January 18 by sending the 29-year-old right-shot defenceman to the Vegas Golden Knights, and the picks were the headline, but an underrated piece of the deal is Zach Whitecloud.
